{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Check for duplicate patient_id
print("Number of unique patient_id:", df['patient_id'].nunique())
print("Total rows:", len(df))

duplicate_patients = df[df['patient_id'].duplicated(keep=False)]
print("Number of rows for duplicate patients:", len(duplicate_patients))

# Step 2: Check sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
sentinel_count = (df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()
print("Number of baseline biomarker = -999:", sentinel_count)
print("Percentage of total:", (sentinel_count / len(df)) * 100)

# Step 3: Check for re-testing (sample_seq > 1)
df_with_retest = df[df['sample_seq'] > 1]
print("Number of re-tested patients (sample_seq > 1):", len(df_with_retest))
print("Number of unique patients with retest:", df_with_retest['patient_id'].nunique())"}
